test_cases.name: Password reset token strength (control)
test_cases.objective: Determine whether reset tokens are unpredictable and attempt-limited.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: Tokens are random, expire, and are invalidated after 5 wrong attempts (HTTP 429/400).

test_cases.name: Session identifier rotation on login (control)
test_cases.objective: Verify that the session identifier changes at authentication.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: sid cookie differs before and after login; old sid is invalid.

test_cases.name: Function-level authorization on audit data (control)
test_cases.objective: Verify only audit.read holders can read audit events.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: 403 for non-admin roles on both routes.

test_cases.name: Object-level authorization on patient summary
test_cases.objective: Verify a doctor cannot read patients outside their care team.
test_cases.preconditions: Patient not assigned to the doctor exists.
test_cases.expected_result: 404/403 for unassigned patients on both routes.

test_cases.name: Object-level authorization on assigned patients (control)
test_cases.objective: Confirm assigned patients remain readable and unassigned patients denied on the secure route.
test_cases.expected_result: Assigned: 200. Unassigned: 404.

test_cases.name: Role-based authorization (control)
test_cases.objective: Confirm role permissions are enforced on admin routes.

test_cases.name: Legacy search query handling (control)
test_cases.objective: Determine whether q is bound as a parameter.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: A quote in q is treated as data; tautology payload does not widen results.

test_cases.name: Secure patient search (control)
test_cases.objective: Confirm GET /api/patients?q= treats input as data.
test_cases.expected_result: Tautology payload returns 0 rows.

test_cases.name: Output encoding of patient notes (control)
test_cases.objective: Determine whether notes HTML is interpreted when rendered.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: Markup is displayed as text.

test_cases.name: Upload validation (control)
test_cases.objective: Determine whether uploads are validated beyond the declared type.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: HTML disguised as PNG is rejected; downloads are attachment+nosniff.

test_cases.name: Security headers (control)
test_cases.objective: Compare security headers across routes.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: All routes send X-Frame-Options, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options.

test_cases.name: Error message disclosure
test_cases.objective: Determine whether errors reveal internals.
test_cases.expected_result: Generic error, no SQL/stack text.

test_cases.name: Profile update field allow-list (control)
test_cases.objective: Determine whether unlisted fields are applied.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: Unlisted fields rejected; role unchanged.

test_cases.name: CSRF controls on state changes (control)
test_cases.objective: Determine whether state-changing requests require an anti-CSRF token.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: Requests without X-CSRF-Token are rejected (403).

test_cases.name: Resource path handling (control)
test_cases.objective: Determine whether file selection is confined to the intended directory.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: Only public-docs files are served.

test_cases.name: Manifest and evidence not publicly served (control)
test_cases.objective: Confirm assessment data is only reachable via assessor permissions.
test_cases.expected_result: Ordinary administrator receives 403.

test_cases.name: Server-side request destinations (control)
test_cases.objective: Determine whether user-supplied URLs can reach internal services.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: Internal and loopback destinations are refused.

test_cases.name: Redirect target validation
test_cases.objective: Determine whether redirects are limited to local paths.
test_cases.expected_result: External targets are rejected.

test_cases.name: Token signature verification (control)
test_cases.objective: Determine whether unsigned tokens are accepted.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: Unsigned or tampered tokens are rejected (401).

test_cases.name: Blind injection resistance (control)
test_cases.objective: Determine whether MRN lookup is parameterised.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: Injected conditions do not change the result.

test_cases.name: Reflected output encoding
test_cases.objective: Determine whether query text is encoded in HTML responses.
test_cases.expected_result: Markup in q is shown as text.

test_cases.name: Login error uniformity
test_cases.objective: Determine whether login errors reveal account existence.
test_cases.expected_result: Identical response for unknown user and wrong password.

test_cases.name: Diagnostic endpoint exposure (control)
test_cases.objective: Determine whether diagnostics are reachable without authentication.
test_cases.expected_result: Remediated: 401/404 for anonymous callers.
